subject: Transient egress notice & DPA amendment request
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@NimbusHealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:12:00Z
Subject: Transient egress notice & DPA amendment request

Hi Rachel,

Quick question from our ops + legal teams. We have a scheduled EU region maintenance window on 2026-11-28 that will temporarily limit local analytics pipelines. To avoid data loss we want to enable a transient (<=72h) failover to your US analytics cluster for a subset of non-identifiable telemetry (service-level metrics, anonymized request metadata).

Before we enable this we need:
- A written assurance that the transient egress is temporary (start/end timestamps) and will not result in persistent cross-border replication.
- Confirmation that data stored in the US will not be used for model training.
- A short list of subprocessors involved in the US analytics path and SOC2 evidence excerpts for those subprocessors.
- A proposed DPA amendment or addendum we can review that documents the temporary egress window and controls.

Our contract reference: HS-9876. Can you confirm Redwood can support this transient egress window and share the needed artifacts? If helpful, loop in legal@NimbusHealth.com.

Thanks,
Oliver
Director of Platform Ops
NimbusHealth
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@NimbusHealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Transient egress notice & DPA amendment request

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can support a scoped, timeboxed failover for analytics and we can provide a DPA amendment template to capture the temporary egress/controls.

High-level plan we propose:
1) Pinning + transient-window: We will keep primary residency in EU for your production traffic. For the maintenance window (you indicate 2026-11-28, up to 72h), we can enable a transient routing policy that forwards a narrow telemetry stream to a US analytics pool. This policy will:
   - Scope by dataset (only the fields you approve),
   - Timebox by start/end timestamps (manual start/auto-stop capability),
   - Block any persistent replication (no background sync after the window).
2) Controls and assurances: We will provide a signed amendment that includes the timebox and an explicit non-replication clause, and we can include a prohibition on training on any data routed as part of this window.
3) Subprocessors & evidence: Attaching our transient-egress-playbook.pdf which lists the subprocessors for analytics and the short soc2-summary.pdf extract. Im also attaching a DPA amendment draft (dpa-amendment-draft.docx) for your legal team to review and redline.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marissa (cced) will confirm the technical gating (which fields can be forwarded and masking options).
- Neha will provide the formal amendment template + proposed signature flow.
- I can schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk legal/ops through the playbook if youd like.

Please confirm who from Nimbus Health legal will review (you mentioned legal@NimbusHealth.com). Once we have a confirmed data field list and the time window we will provide a signed amendment with a HubSpot reference (HS-9876) and a Drive link to the playbook.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: transient-egress-playbook.pdf, dpa-amendment-draft.docx, soc2-summary.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@NimbusHealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Transient egress notice & DPA amendment request

On Sat, Nov 21, 2026 at 10:05 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can support a scoped, timeboxed failover for analytics and we can provide a DPA amendment template to capture the temporary egress/controls.

Adding technical detail for ops:
- Data types allowed in the transient window: only aggregated metrics and anonymized request metadata. No PII, no user identifiers, no logs that contain full request payloads. We can implement a field-level allowlist prior to enabling the window.
- Replication behavior: the routing policy is stateless for the transient channel — we do not initiate background replication back to EU once the window closes. The routed objects are written to a dedicated US namespace which we mark for retention <=72h by default; we can shorten to 24h on request.
- Keys & encryption: Customer-controlled KMS is supported for Dedicated/Private customers. For Hosted customers we use our HSM-managed keys; we can add a certificate and KMS audit excerpt in the SOC2 summary.
- Subprocessors: the analytics pipeline uses Redwood Analytics Inc. (US) and a cloud partner (us-east-1). The playbook has a minimal subprocessor roster (see attached). Any addition to that roster triggers a notification to NimbusHealth per the DPA addendum.

Operational ask for Nimbus: please provide the exact field allowlist (CSV or schema) and the preferred start timestamp for the maintenance window. We will run a dry-run in our staging cluster (no customer data) before the scheduled window.

—Marissa
Principal Product Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: legal@NimbusHealth.com <legal@NimbusHealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Transient egress notice & DPA amendment request

Rachel / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses and the draft materials. A few items our counsel needs before we can approve the temporary egress: 
1) A signed amendment template that explicitly states: the data subset, the timebox, a non-replication clause, and a prohibition on model training.
2) Confirmation that Redwood will delete any routed telemetry in the US namespace within 24 hours of the window closing (we prefer 24h).
3) A short SOC2 excerpt that covers the Redwood Analytics Inc. environment (we got the soc2-summary.pdf but need the control mapping for subprocessors).
4) A copy of the DPA amendment in PDF form we can sign and a DocuSign link or instructions.

We attach a signed-amendment-template.pdf with our preferred language edits (see attachment). If Redwood agrees to the 24h deletion and the non-training clause we can sign the amendment the same day. Please advise on next steps and whether you can provide a DocuSign link.

Regards,
A. Legal Counsel
NimbusHealth

Attachment: signed-amendment-template.pdf
